requirements.desc: Timeout exits identified by SIGTERM from agent subprocess timeout must be retried by _callOnceWithRetry until the normalized retryCount is exhausted; after exhaustion, the final timeout error must be thrown.
requirements.note: R1: timeout exits retry until retryCount is exhausted

requirements.desc: Built-in codex profiles used by ProviderRegistry must keep --json in args and jsonOutputFlag set to --json for codex/gpt-5.4 and codex/gpt-5.3.
requirements.note: R2: built-in codex profiles keep literal JSON output configuration

requirements.desc: Agent errors that include captured stdout must include provider key, profile key, and a stdout preview capped at 200 characters in the thrown error message.
requirements.note: R3: timeout errors include provider, profile, and a capped stdout preview

requirements.desc: docs text batch JSON parse failures must throw an error containing the file name and a preview of the normalized agent response capped at 200 characters.
requirements.note: R4: batch JSON parse errors include file name and normalized response preview

requirements.desc: docs text batch JSON parse failures must preserve fail-fast behavior: the affected file is counted as an error and the command exits non-zero through the existing DocsTextCommand error path.
requirements.note: R5: command-level batch JSON parse failures report file errors and non-zero exit

requirements.desc: Regression coverage must include spec-local tests for timeout retry, codex JSON profile settings, and docs text parse error preview without waiting for a real 300 second codex CLI timeout.
requirements.note: R6: this spec-local file covers every testable requirement without a long codex CLI timeout
